summary: Embraer S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing minutes of an Extraordinary General Meeting held October 30, 2026, attended by shareholders representing 68.91% of capital. The agenda covered approval of the Protocol and Justification for the merger of wholly owned subsidiary Embraer GPX Ltda. into Embraer, ratification of Forvis Mazars as appraisal firm, approval of the appraisal report of GPX net equity as of June 30, 2026, and authorization of the Executive Board. The merger is effective October 31, 2026. This is an internal upstream merger of a controlled entity, not a special situation; no price, premium, or deal consideration applies. Watch only for post-merger corporate simplification disclosures.
